methodology: Predeclared promising candidates; two new deterministic workloads, same broad class counts and Node timing method, plus the original accepted/rejected example records as separate classes. Reverse candidate order on second seed. No tuning after confirmation.
pythonMethodology: Same unmodified validator and class checks; 3 rotating rounds per new seed. Each broad valid/invalid round traverses all 32 records; each original example is repeated 32 times; malformed rounds repeat the 8 records 512 times to stabilize their much shorter timings.
